lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 fixed the post-merge checkout-main bug: runPostMerge now does git checkout main before git pull origin main (mirrors the must-be-on-main guard in tag.ts:66-79). Without this, git pull merges origin/main into the feature branch, rev-parse HEAD returns the feature SHA (wrong tag target), and branch -d fails because you cannot delete the checked-out branch. Added unit tests for checkout-main-failed path and a real-git integration test (test/integration/post-merge-on-main.test.ts) that verifies the tag SHA matches main HEAD and branchPrunedLocal is true. 1650 tests pass.
